gomind.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
gomind.faq.q1: How long did the GoMind project take?
gomind.faq.a1: The redesign of the GoMind showcase website took about 4 months, including the visual identity, the design system, the AI mascot generator and the website development.
gomind.faq.q2: What is an ESN, and why did GoMind need a redesign?
gomind.faq.a2: An ESN (Entreprise de Services du Numérique) is a French IT services company. GoMind, which specializes in GreenIT, needed a redesign to modernize its image, improve B2B client acquisition and better communicate its environmental values.
gomind.faq.q3: What is the AI mascot generator built for GoMind?
gomind.faq.a3: The AI mascot generator is an interactive tool that lets website visitors create a personalized mascot. This innovative feature boosts engagement and sets GoMind apart from its competitors in the ESN sector.
gomind.faq.q4: What were the goals of this showcase website redesign?
gomind.faq.a4: The main goals were to modernize the visual identity to reflect GoMind's GreenIT expertise, improve B2B client acquisition, create an engaging user experience, and build a reusable design system for future projects.
gomind.faq.q5: Which technologies were used for GoMind?
gomind.faq.a5: The project was designed in Figma, including a complete design system. The website uses modern technologies for the AI mascot generator and an architecture optimized for performance and accessibility.
